Text:
Herne Hill Market by the station is a good place to start, with hot food and local produce right next to Brockwell Park. Walk it off up the hill, then head over to the Ivy House in Nunhead for a pint and a long lunch in that old panelled room.

Save this for a Sunday when you've got nowhere to be.

At the Kiln Rooms in Peckham you're both covered in clay within ten minutes, so the conversation tends to sort itself out. If pottery isn't it, bouldering at the Castle in Stoke Newington is a bit silly and leaves no room for awkward pauses, and it's inside an old water tower.

Send this to someone who goes quiet over dinner but won't stop talking once they've got something to do.
